Presentation upload endpoint validates file type (PDF/PPTX only) and host/coordinator authorization

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 143 verified AI Meeting Notes and Presentation features. Key findings: 1) All backend endpoints return correct 404/400 responses for error cases, 2) Recordings page shows 3 local recordings (no cloud recordings with completed transcription - so AI Notes button not visible), 3) WebinarLiveRoom loads correctly with noise cancellation toggle visible in control bar, 4) SlideRenderer shows upload button when no presentation exists. The login flow requires both 'token' and 'karau_user' in localStorage. WebinarLiveRoom URL pattern is /karau-meet/webinar/{id}/live.
